entities.summary: Count Yurii Alexandrovich Golovkin (1762–1846) was a Russian diplomat who served as Russian minister (ambassador) in Stuttgart (1813–18) and in Vienna (1818–1822), but is best remembered for his leadership of the ambitious mission to China despatched in 1805.
